{{Top|leg}}
The '''Dor'shan spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Dor'shan/Legends|Dor'shan]] on the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]].

The spaceport consisted of several domed docks; all unloading areas were inside, to keep those not native to the world safe from the poisonous gases of the atmosphere.
